source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1121 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1121 was established by Ordinance No. 32917, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 13, 2024. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1121 is established on property generally located southwest of the intersection of Elam Road and Buckner Boulevard. The size of PD 1121 is approximately 12.175 acres. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Definitions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.103. DEFINITIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions in Chapter 51A and Division 51A-13.200 apply to this article.

(b) In this article:

(1) PROJECTING ATTACHED SIGN means an attached premise sign projecting more than 12 inches from the building at an angle other than parallel to the facade.

(2) TRANSIT PROMENADE means a central corridor that provides a public pedestrian connection between the intersection of Elam Road and Buckner Boulevard and the Dallas Area Rapid Transit (DART) Buckner Station. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.104. INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) In general.

(1) Unless otherwise stated, Article XIII, “Form Districts,” of Chapter 51A applies to this article.

(2) Unless otherwise stated, the interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(3) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(b) Conflicts.

(1) If there is a conflict between the provisions of Article XIII and the remainder of Chapter 51A, Article XIII controls.

(2) If there is a conflict between the provisions of this article and Article XIII, this article controls.

(3) If there is a conflict between the text of this article and any of the exhibits, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.105. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article: Exhibit 1121A: enhanced conceptual plan. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Enhanced Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.106. ENHANCED CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

(a) Development and use of the property must comply with the enhanced conceptual plan (Exhibit 1121A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the enhanced conceptual plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) An enhanced conceptual plan must depict internal drives, which must be finished out as primary frontages for purposes of streetscapes, building frontage, and development standards for any given development type. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Site Plan And Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.107. SITE PLAN AND DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Site plan. A site plan that complies with the requirements of this article and Section 51A-13.703, “Site Plan Review,” must be submitted to the building official when required by Section 51A-13.703(a).

(b) Development plan. No development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: District Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.108. DISTRICT REGULATIONS.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this article, the district regulations for the WMU- 5 Walkable Urban Mixed Use District apply.

(b) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 304.

(c) Height.

(1) In general. Except as provided in this subsection, maximum structure height is 60 feet.

(2) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Except for chimneys, structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less. Chimneys may project through the slope to a height 12 feet above the slope and 12 feet above the maximum structure height.
(3) Residential proximity slope bonus. If compliant with Section 51P- 1121.116, the residential proximity slope regulations of Sections 51A-4.412 and 51A-13.302(f)(1) do not apply to the development.

(d) Street standards. Primary street standards such as, setbacks, frontage percentages, transparency, entrance requirements, blank wall maximums, and parking setbacks, must be provided along public streets and internal streets with a pavement width of 25 feet or wider and along transit promenades. Side street standards control along internal street with pavement width of less than 25 feet.

(e) Existing parking area. Development of the area marked on the enhanced conceptual plan as existing parking area is permitted in accordance with the district regulations for the WMU- 5 Walkable Urban Mixed Use District and this article. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) In general. No minimum off-street parking or loading is required.

(b) Multifamily uses. The maximum spaces allowed for a multifamily use is:

(1) One-bedroom units. 1.15 parking spaces per unit.

(2) Two-bedroom units. 1.65 parking spaces per unit.

(3) Three or more-bedroom units. Two parking spaces per unit.

(c) Maximum surface parking. The maximum number of surface parking spaces permitted for a transit passenger station use is 125, excluding any parallel or indented parking spaces located in the public right-of-way or the main driveway serving the DART station. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article XIII.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(c) All on-street and site trees qualify as site trees.

(d) In areas where the director determines a utility conflict exists, a single small tree may be used to satisfy the requirement of a large canopy tree for the purposes of Section 51A- 13.501.

(e) The berming and shrubs existing on November 13, 2024 may be used to satisfy the parking screening requirements between the DART surface parking lots and Elam Road and Buckner Boulevard.

(f) Elam Road and Buckner Boulevard street trees and landscaping provisions must comply with this subsection.

(1) One small tree is required per 40 linear feet of street frontage planted in a minimum six-foot wide planting zone. In areas where the director determines a utility conflict exists, the tree planting zone is permitted between the door yard and the pedestrian zone.

(2) The existing planting zone, which includes screening of parking from street frontages, one canopy tree per 40 linear feet of street frontage and ground cover in open areas, and a sidewalk between the DART parking lot and Elam Road, may remain as existing on November 13, 2024. The exemption in this paragraph expires if the parking lot is redeveloped. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Open Space
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.112. OPEN SPACE.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, open space provided under this section must comply with the requirements for open space in Section 51A-13.303, “Open Space,” and Subsection (k), “Open Space Lot,” of Section 51A-13.304, “Development Types.”

(b) Site plan. Compliance with open space requirements must be shown on a site plan and demonstrated at the time of application for any building permit for new construction or a major renovation.

(c) Minimum on-site requirement. A minimum of eight percent of a lot or building site must be maintained as open space.

(d) Location requirement. A minimum 2,000 square feet of contiguous open space is required within 75 feet of the corner of the intersection of Elam Road and Buckner Boulevard. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.113. SIGNS.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with Article XIII.

(b) Projecting attached sign.

(1) One projecting attached sign is permitted along each public street frontage. One additional projecting attached sign is permitted on the private driveway adjacent to the DART station.

(2) A projecting attached sign must:

(A) have a vertical orientation with height exceeding the width at a minimum 16:99 height-to-width ratio;

(B) have a minimum clearance of 15 feet above a sidewalk if located over any portion of a sidewalk or door yard; and

(C) not exceed a maximum sign face area of 45 square feet. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Street Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.114. STREET STANDARDS.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, streets, alleys, and driveways are required in accordance with Division 51A-13.500.

(b) Sidewalks.

(1) In general.

(A) Sidewalks must be continuous and level across all driveways and curb cuts and designed to be at the same grade as the existing sidewalk, subject to approval by the director.

(B) At each intersection of driveway and sidewalk, crosswalks must be constructed of a material that differs in finish and color from that of vehicular ingress and egress driveways.

(2) Along public streets. Sidewalks with an unobstructed width of eight feet are required within the sidewalk zone. Tree wells may encroach into the sidewalk zone provided there is a minimum of six feet of unobstructed pedestrian pathway.

(3) Along internal driveways shown on the conceptual plan. Sidewalks with an unobstructed width of six feet are required within the sidewalk zone.

(4) Transit promenade.

(A) Two elevated “tabletop” crosswalks with a minimum width of 12 feet and an enhanced surface material (e.g. stamped and colored concrete or pavers) must be provided on the internal driveway to connect the public promenade to the DART station.

(B) The public promenade satisfies pedestrian passage requirements for the site. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Transit Promenade Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.115. TRANSIT PROMENADE STANDARDS.

(a) A transit promenade must have a minimum overall width of 25 feet with a minimum unobstructed width of 12 feet of clear pedestrian pathway.

(b) One canopy tree is required every 30 linear feet on both sides of the promenade.

(c) Wayfinding monument signs no taller than four feet are permitted within 30 feet of a public street at the entrance to the transit promenade. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Development           Bonuses        For     Mixed       Income
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.116. DEVELOPMENT BONUSES FOR MIXED INCOME HOUSING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the development bonus identified in Section 51P-1121.108 applies if a minimum of five percent of the total number of units are made available to households earning between 81 percent to 100 percent of the area median family income and are in compliance with Division 51A-4.1100, as amended.

(b) Design standards. Compliance with 51A-4.1107 is not required. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.117. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) In general.

(1) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(2) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) Fencing.

(1) A maximum six-foot-tall metal fence with a minimum of opacity 30 percent is permitted in the front yard along Elam Road.

(2) A maximum six-foot tall metal and masonry fence is permitted in the front yard along Buckner Boulevard and along both sides of the public promenade provided the solid masonry portion of the fence is no higher than three feet from grade. The portion of the fence greater than three feet from grade may be decorative metal with at least 30 percent opacity.
(3) The apartment residents’ common areas and courtyards may have access controls to demarcate public space from private space.

(4) Ground floor units facing Elam Road, Buckner Boulevard, and the DART station with fencing must be designed in such a way to allow direct access from the units to the sidewalk. (Ord. 32917)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1121.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32917)
